name: Cruel Intent strikes three extra auto attacks when a Lunge lands (#2336)
contract: Cruel Intent 704653 reads 'When you Lunge at an enemy you now strike them 3 times with auto attacks.' Its effect is aura 42 (SPELL_AURA_PROC_TRIGGER_SPELL) with EffectTriggerSpell 707599 (SPELL_EFFECT_ADD_EXTRA_ATTACKS, BasePoints 2 + DieSides 1 = 3, on the caster), ProcChance 100 and Spell.dbc ProcFlags 0x0, so without a spell_proc row SpellMgr::LoadSpellProcs generated nothing and the aura never procced. Lunge 500126 is the only family-26 record with SpellFamilyFlags (16777216, 0, 0); it has DmgClass NONE and is harmful, so the row belongs on ProcFlags 4096 (PROC_FLAG_DONE_SPELL_NONE_DMG_CLASS_NEG) with SpellPhaseMask 2 (HIT) and Chance 0, the same shape as the live Dark Intent heal row 707622. Lunge requires Cursed Form (CasterAuraSpell 525031) and costs 8% maximum health, so the fixture enters Accursed Form 562572 first. The harness all-spell cast hook records the triggered 707599 cast as a proc against 704653 and as a cast of 707599, and the queued extra attacks are asserted as three extra main-hand melee packets landing on the Lunge target.
